summary: Frontend-only verification of the Mexico-time (UTC-6) embalming date/time bug fix in the case create/edit form and report preview. Full round-trip works: entered start 2026-06-01 09:00 and end 2026-06-01 11:30 (Mexico wall-clock), saved, reopened for edit, and the fields reloaded with the SAME values (no 6h shift, no date roll to 2026-06-02). 'Ahora' buttons populated current Mexico wall-clock time (2026-09-01 11:31, matching UTC-6). Report PDF preview (Reporte tab -> preview-report-button) rendered successfully with Fecha de embalsamamiento 01/06/2026, Inicio 01/06/2026 09:00, Término 01/06/2026 11:30, Tiempo consumido 2 h 30 min, and Generado in MX time (01/09/2026 11:32). Test case was deleted via API.

rca_of_issue: Previously the form stored the raw HH:MM string as if it were UTC, so 09:00 MX became 09:00Z which is 03:00 MX after re-display, and downstream date computations rolled by +1 day near midnight. Fix: mxToISO composes `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:00-06:00` and stores the ISO UTC, while splitMx subtracts 6h from the stored UTC and reads getUTC* fields to recover the exact Mexico wall-clock. Verified end-to-end via UI round-trip and via the server-rendered PDF.
